description: Build inspiration and techniques curated from PlanetMinecraft's most popular and detailed projects. Used to train agents to build impressive structures.
note: Initially seeded with popular builds. Run scripts/scrape-planetminecraft.js every 3 days to update.

universalTips: Always gather reference images before starting large builds
Build a small test version first to check proportions
Use depth - no flat walls, add layers and texture
Mix block types within the same material family for variation
Light your builds properly - both for mob spawning and aesthetics
Add small details: buttons, trapdoors, flower pots, item frames
Consider how builds will look from different angles/distances
Use the environment - integrate builds with terrain when possible
Create pathways and landscaping around structures
Add life: animals, villagers, armor stands, paintings
